thread:
sara: kicking off a config-only deploy for tinybatch limiter (canary cohorts A-C). change window 22:00-23:30 PT. tagging @lia @matt. deploy-bot will do staged waves with dry-run on — shout now if there's an objection.

deploy-bot: release queued "tinybatch-limiter-v2" -> canary groups [cohort-A, cohort-B, cohort-C]. dry-run: true. waves: 10%, 30%, 60%. auto-fallback enabled.

lia: quick question — what's our plan if kv-cache pressure increases across canaries? full rollback or tenant-scoped mitigation?

matt: leaning tenant-scoped mitigation. plan: auto-route-fallback to compat-model-smallburst + tenant pin to prior config for 60m. trigger if error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency > 800ms.

sara: adding those thresholds to the deploy manifest now. snippet: 

```
batching:
  target_tokens: 32
  max_batch_delay_ms: 30
fallback:
  on_error_rate: 0.015
  on_latency_p95_ms: 800
route_policy:
  prefer: low-latency
  fallback_model: compat-model-smallburst
pin_policy:
  scope: tenant
  duration_minutes: 60
```

ops-bot: preflight OK — node health green, kv-cache free ~46%, queued req distribution nominal. infra headroom OK.

deploy-bot: wave1 (10%) applied at 22:05 PT — health-check window 2m.

lia: watching dashboards — small tail latency bump on tenant-42 (+120ms) but error rate 0.6%.

matt: hold next wave 5m. try reducing max_batch_delay_ms to 25 and re-evaluate. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara: making a scoped tweak, re-applying on wave1 nodes only. will not advance to wave2 until metrics look stable.

deploy-bot: wave1 re-applied with max_batch_delay_ms=25 -> snapshot: error_rate=0.5%, p95=710ms.

lia: did tenant-42 get a pin or just route-fallback during that spike?

matt: we pinned tenant-42 to previous-config v1 for 60m (tenant-scoped rollback). route-fallback remains available as secondary safety.

deploy-bot: tenant-42 pinned -> previous-config v1. auto-unpin scheduled +60m. :white_check_mark:

sara: cohorts look stable. plan: proceed with 30% wave after 10m observation. drafting release notes: 
- reduced tinybatch max_batch_delay from 30ms -> 25ms to cut tail latency
- tenant-level rollback (60m default) for config-only batch changes
- auto fallback to compat-model-smallburst on elevated errors/latency

matt: I'll open the release-note PR and link it here. assigning @lia for final copy review.

lia: will review. I'll monitor for 30m post-ramp and escalate if anything crosses thresholds.

deploy-bot: wave2 scheduled 22:20 PT (30%) with 3m monitoring windows. alerts escalate to #eng-oncall if error_rate > 1%.

sara: nice work. will add a note to the runbook about preferring tenant-scope pins + fallback routes rather than global rollbacks for config-only tuning. :rocket:

matt: agreed — scoped pins avoid noisy global churn. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: post-deploy summary with metric links will post to #eng-sre in ~45m.

lia: capturing this as a runbook tweak: tenant-pin + compat-model fallback for tinybatch tweaks.

sara: closing thread after wave2 observation unless someone requests rollback.

deploy-bot: wave2 applied -> metrics steady. no escalations. final: canary rollout continuing, next wave at 22:40 PT.
